goal: Wave 2 build: telemetry actually leaves the process (code half); skill-write policy and promotion re-check; Read-only workspace tools behind WORKSPACE_TOOLS

slices.title: telemetry actually leaves the process (code half)
slices.summary: Lets the security events leave the process: adds the mp.v1.security.* publish grant to model-gateway-runtime in nats.conf, removes the registry gap, and adds the tool-screening and semantic-screening counters, with CONTENT_SAFETY_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE declared in compose. Additive; rollback reverts the conf line.
slices.remaining: Code half: The telemetry export fix with tests and an in-process capture test.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway --lib security_events semantic_screening
slices.notes: Do NOT edit these shared files (the lead applies your exact lines after the batch; put them in lead_todo as 'shared-edit <file>: <exact lines>'): apps/Model Plane/deploy/docker-compose.yml

slices.title: skill-write policy and promotion re-check
slices.summary: Adds write_policy::check_skill to background-review skill upserts (a refusal returns the existing response shape with skip_reason and writes no row) and re-checks stored content when a learned skill is enabled; capability-core maps the skip to a counted skip with no retry. User-origin writes are report-only.
test_commands: ignored PG tests: background_review_skill_with_marker_is_refused, enable_of_learned_skill_rechecks_policy, user_origin_skill_is_reported_not_refused; extend assert_upsert_skill_guards

decisions_defaults.DEC-31 (WS26-D6): (DEC-31 (WS26-D6)) Shared crate. Default mode `frame` (today's behaviour); `tighten` per-org opt-in; `enforce` per-org opt-in after S8 thresholds, never for ThirdPartyMcp until WS05. Fail open by default, `degraded` as org option. Mode in `safety_policies.con

slices.title: Read-only workspace tools behind WORKSPACE_TOOLS
slices.summary: Adds four read tools (workspace_read, workspace_grep, workspace_glob, workspace_list) offered only to Space-scoped runs that are not ZDR or waived, when WORKSPACE_TOOLS is read or all. They dispatch through the signed capability gate as cap.workspace.read (migration 0018), which must be advertised, bound, seeded and attested. Off by default in code and compose.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go test ./... && go vet ./... && go test -tags integration ./internal/registry/...
slices.flag: WORKSPACE_TOOLS=off|read|all (execution-core env; default off in code and compose; read then all on the proof stack)
